event_name: Date 21 October 2018 Time 13:47 2018 UNITED STATES GRAND PRIX 18 - 21 October 2018 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Car 18 collided with car 14 in turn 4.
offence: Involved in an incident as defined by Article 38.1 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
penalty: Drive through penalty (2 penalty points awarded, 7 points for the 12 month period)
reason: The Stewards reviewed the video evidence, noting that during the first lap car 18 left the track and while re-joining at turn 4 made contact with car 14. As a result of the incident car 14 retired. The Stewards considered that the driver of car 18 is fully to blame for the incident.

stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
